realm.name: whitelist-reviewer
realm.description: Can review, approve, reject whitelist applications and manage per-server whitelist settings.

realm.name: staff
realm.description: Can view and moderate player accounts (search, lock/unlock) via the web portal's admin Accounts page.

realm.name: admin
realm.description: Can grant and revoke realm roles on any account.

realm.name: server-admin
realm.description: Can manage per-server settings (e.g. the whitelist enabled toggle).

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: accounts:bohemia-gameaccount:manage
clientScopes.description: Mint game-account link PINs and resolve Bohemia ID bindings. Trusted server-to-server callers only - never grant to a public or user-facing client.

clientScopes.name: bohemia-id
clientScopes.description: Carries the bound Bohemia ID as the bohemia_id claim. Absent claim means the account is not linked.
